metadata.question: Did Wilmington, North Carolina receive at least 90 inches of rainfall during the year of 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: Use the NASA/ORNL/DAYMET_V4 image collection. It provides daily precipitation (prcp) in mm/day for North America at a 1 km resolution. This merges cloud-free reanalysis with station data and is ideal for annual totals. - Date: "2018" → filter date range 2018-01-01 to 2018-12-31. - Location: Wilmington, NC ≈ (-77.9447, 34.2257). Create a small Point geometry. 2. Masking: The collection is reanalysis – no cloud masking required. 3. Logic: - STEP-1: Grab collection; if size() == 0 → print & output C1. - STEP-2: Sum daily prcp (mm) into annual total; then convert to inches (25.4 mm per inch). - STEP-3: Sum over point using reduceRegion (Reducer.sum() for annual total in mm, scale 1000). - Check: prcp_sum should be a finite number; if None/NaN → C3. - If valid: compare the annual inches total ≥ 90. - Print concise evidence. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # Geometry & time pt = ee.Geometry.Point([-77.9447, 34.2257]) start, end = '2018-01-01', '2018-12-31' # Grab precipitation collection col = (ee.ImageCollection('NASA/ORNL/DAYMET_V4') .select('prcp') .filterDate(start, end)) if col.size().getInfo() == 0: print("No data for 2018.") print("C1") # Empty collection else: # Sum all daily prcp (mm) over 2018 annualSum = col.sum().multiply(0.001) # now m/day summed → m/yr mm_sum = annualSum.multiply(1000) # annual sum (mm/yr) # convert to inches inchesSum = mm_sum.divide(25.4) # inches # Extract value at point prcpInches = inchesSum.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.first(), geometry=pt, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('prcp').getInfo() if prcpInches is None or ee.Algorithms.IsValid(prcpInches).getInfo() == 0: print("Calculation failure.") print("C3") else: print(f"Annual 2018 rainfall: {prcpInches:.1f} inches at point") print("A" if prcpInches >= 90 else "B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# Geometry & time
pt = ee.Geometry.Point([-77.9447, 34.2257])
start, end = '2018-01-01', '2018-12-31'

# Grab precipitation collection
col = (ee.ImageCollection('NASA/ORNL/DAYMET_V4')
       .select('prcp')
       .filterDate(start, end))
if col.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No data for 2018.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")  # Empty collection
else:
    # Sum all daily prcp (mm) over 2018
    annualSum = col.sum().multiply(0.001)  # now m/day summed → m/yr
    mm_sum = annualSum.multiply(1000)      # annual sum (mm/yr)
    # convert to inches
    inchesSum = mm_sum.divide(25.4)  # inches
    # Extract value at point
    prcpInches = inchesSum.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.first(),
                                        geometry=pt,
                                        scale=1000,
                                        maxPixels=1e9).get('prcp').getInfo()
    if prcpInches is None or ee.Algorithms.IsValid(prcpInches).getInfo() == 0:
        print("Calculation failure.")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    else:
        print(f"Annual 2018 rainfall: {prcpInches:.1f} inches at point")
        print("<answer>A</answer>" if prcpInches >= 90 else "<answer>B</answer>")
